_about: brake1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/brake1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

ab.skid.enter._orig: the spin taken out of the body: the arms flung wide to catch the air, one leg reaching ahead

ab.skid.hold._orig: braced against the way he travels: the torso leaned back, the knees bent and the feet reaching toward the travel, both forearms up and forward, the head up and looking along it
